title: 경로 분석
description: 여러 변수가 어떻게 이어지는지 경로 모형으로 살펴봅니다. 변수를 순서(단계)에 넣고 데이터에서 구조를 찾거나 직접 지정한 뒤, 직접·간접·총효과를 나누고 공변인을 안내합니다. 작은 표본을 위한 연결 안정성과 베이지안 추정을 함께 씁니다.

assistant.summary: Path analysis / exploratory causal graph for several observed variables, aimed at small samples where covariates and routes are unknown. Variables go into ordered tiers (background, early, middle, outcome); arrows only run forward. The graph is learned from the data under the tier order (bnlearn bootstrap model averaging, hc/tabu/PC-stable, with required and forbidden links), taken as every forward path (saturated), or given as a path list (hypothesis/mediation models). Estimated with lavaan (ML, bootstrap or Monte Carlo intervals, FIML) or blavaan (Bayesian). Reports link stability, path coefficients, R², a tidySEM path diagram, the direct / path-specific indirect / total effect decomposition of a chosen X -> Y, covariate roles (confounder, mediator, collider) with dagitty minimal adjustment sets and a button to open the adjusted regression, fit indices, Bollen-Stine p and modification indices.
